Band 12 has n_within_pairs=6 and n_between_pairs=114 because four domain trajectories stop at turnover 11.75 (noise s2 FAILED; philosophy s1, programming s2, war s2 COMPLETED with 47 chunks). Band 10 still has the full 80/1440 pair set and also excludes 0; it is not the pre-registered F4 number. Do not impute missing last-band pairs. Do not replace archival 0.201 [0.065, 0.332].
